title: PREVIEW: the function networks, step by step, with the experiments (simulated; twin video)
description:
PREVIEW for review, not a public cut: the function-network chapter of the twin's campaign video, rebuilt to show each step as the experiment and the data it makes.

Everything is simulated unless a label on screen says otherwise. The curves, micrographs and maps are the digital twin's own models and instrument simulators run for two alloys of round 3b's replay: aluminium design 299 of seed 0 (Al-3.3Mn-0.8Cr-0.3Ti-0.3Li-0.2Er-...) and copper design 74 of seed 5 (Cu-7.4Al-2.7Ni-0.3Ti). They are those alloys' simulated data, not the replayed runs' own draws, at stated example settings. Schematics are labelled illustrative; the atomizer footage is the lab's own (630 bronze, 27 Oct 2026: another alloy); the pictures of stations are the lab's 3-D model. Nothing here is Thermo-Calc output or real SEM data.

0:00 Two campaigns, one lab: the function networks
0:27 Composition: one design in its search space
0:55 CALPHAD: Scheil solidification
1:29 The AM module: one laser track
1:57 Atomizing: the alloy becomes powder
2:21 Printing: nine cubes, nine settings
2:48 SEM: one beam, four signals
3:26 Heat treatment, then the tensile test
3:57 Copper: one hour in the screen, thirty days in seawater
4:31 Both campaigns, one lab
